ssh_plugin_description: Lets agents run commands on computers without Mannie over SSH. You approve each command unless a permission, a rule or full access covers it.
ssh_start_failed: The SSH plugin could not read its hosts. Restart Mannie, then turn the plugin on again.
ssh_settings_description: Computers without Mannie where agents run commands over SSH. Mannie keeps each host's password in your system's credential store.
ssh_list_failed_title: The SSH hosts could not be loaded
ssh_empty_description: Add a computer that you reach over SSH with a user name and a password. Agents can then run commands on it, and you approve each one.
ssh_host_description: Mannie keeps the password in your system's credential store, and sends it only to this host once you have trusted the host's key.
ssh_field_name_description: How you and the agents call the host, as in @build-box: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.
ssh_field_address_description: The host's name or IP address, without a user or a port.
ssh_field_username_description: The account that runs the commands. Give it only the rights that the agents' work needs.
ssh_field_password_description: Mannie hides the password in command output when it has at least {count} characters.
ssh_field_password_keep: Leave the password empty to keep the current one.
ssh_field_note_description: What agents should know about the host, such as its purpose. They read it as information from you, and it gives them no permissions.
ssh_invalid_name: Enter a name of letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens that starts with a letter or a digit.
ssh_invalid_address: Enter a host name or an IP address, without a user, a port or a scheme.
ssh_invalid_username: Enter a user name without spaces.
ssh_invalid_password: Enter a password of at most 1,024 bytes.
ssh_invalid_note: Shorten the note to at most 500 characters, without control characters.
ssh_key_description: Compare the fingerprint with the one that the host prints, for example with ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub. Trust the key only when both are the same.
ssh_key_same: The host shows the key that you trusted.
ssh_key_changed_warning: The host shows another key than the one that you trusted. Unless you reinstalled the host or changed its keys, another computer may be posing as it.
ssh_scan_failed_title: The host key could not be read
ssh_remove_description: Mannie deletes the host's password and forgets the host. Permissions and rules for its commands stay in the Tools settings until you revoke them.
ssh_error_name_taken: Another host has this name. Choose another name.
ssh_error_host_not_found: The host is no longer registered.
ssh_error_unreachable: The host could not be reached. Check its address and port, and that it is on.
ssh_error_timed_out: The host did not answer in time. Check that it is on and reachable, then try again.
ssh_error_handshake_failed: The SSH connection could not be set up. Check that the port belongs to an SSH server.
ssh_error_host_key_unsupported: The host offers only keys that Mannie does not accept, such as RSA keys. Add an Ed25519 or ECDSA host key on the host.
ssh_error_host_key_changed: The host showed another key than the trusted one, so the password was not sent. Check the key.
ssh_error_host_key_not_trusted: Check and trust the host's key first.
ssh_error_scan_outdated: The host's key changed after it was read. Read the key again.
ssh_error_auth_failed: The host refused the user name or the password. Edit the host to correct them.
ssh_error_auth_method_unsupported: The host takes no password login. Mannie logs in with a password or with keyboard-interactive login.
ssh_error_password_missing: The host has no password. Edit the host and enter it.
ssh_error_credential_store_unavailable: Mannie could not use your system's credential store. Check that it is available, then try again.
ssh_error_storage_failed: Mannie could not save the change. Try again.
ssh_mention_summary_host: The agent knows this host and its address
ssh_mention_host_not_found: The SSH host is no longer registered.
ssh_tool_not_started: Mannie did not take the command, so it asked the host to end it.
